facts.fact: Disrupt Africa's 2025 funding report counts two Rwandan tech startups that raised USD 11.2 million between them in 2025; it names neither the financiers nor the startups, and does not say where the financiers are from.
facts.system: Disrupt Africa 2025 tally: two Rwandan startups

note: Only a country tally for Rwanda; no individual deal named.
